description: Back from holiday and Windows says my password has expired, but it won't take any new password I try.
My login keeps getting locked every few minutes, IT unlocked it this morning and it's locked again already.
I switched to a new phone over the weekend and now the sign-in approvals still go to my old one which I've wiped.
I moved to the finance team last week and I get access denied on their shared drive. My manager approved it.
Working from home today and the VPN refuses to connect, it complains about my certificate.
VPN connects but everything crawls, file copies take forever and my calls keep dropping while I'm on it.
My laptop was reimaged yesterday and now it won't join the office wireless, guest wifi works though.
The company intranet page won't open, says it can't find the server, but Google loads fine.
Outlook has been stuck saying updating inbox all morning, but I can see the new emails in the web version.
People tell me their emails to me bounce because my mailbox is full. I already emptied the deleted folder.
When I share my screen in a Teams meeting everyone just sees black. Only happens on my second monitor.
Running the month end report in SAP crashes with a runtime error after a few minutes. Finance is waiting on it.
New contacts I add in Salesforce don't show up in Outlook anymore, it stopped after I changed my password.
Nobody in our office can open the HR portal, it just shows an internal server error. Payroll is due today.
After this morning's update my laptop shows a blue screen asking for a BitLocker recovery key.
The big printer by the pantry keeps saying paper jam even though I opened it and there's nothing in there.
My second screen shows no signal when I plug into the docking station. The monitor works with other laptops.
Adobe Acrobat now says my licence has expired and wants me to buy a subscription. I need to edit a contract today.
Windows updates have been failing all week and I got an email saying my laptop is out of compliance.
Got an email that looks like it's from IT asking me to confirm my password through a link. I didn't click it.
The coffee machine on the 4th floor is leaking water all over the counter.
Can someone book a meeting room for 12 people next Tuesday afternoon?
My payslip shows the wrong number of leave days this month.
The lift on the east side has been stuck on floor 2 since this morning.
I need a new office chair, mine is broken and hurting my back.
Who do I talk to about changing my bank details for salary?
The fire alarm test is too loud in our area, can it be scheduled differently?
Our team needs a quote for 50 branded t-shirts for the offsite.
The cafeteria card reader charged me twice for lunch.
I'd like to request a standing desk for health reasons.
Please update my surname in the staff directory after my wedding.
The windows in the conference room don't close properly and it's cold.
Where can I find the travel reimbursement policy for international trips?
The office plants on our floor haven't been watered in weeks.
Can facilities fix the flickering ceiling light above my desk?
